title: Function-valued path indicator expansion
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $T$ be a real-output decision tree whose queries are restricted to a set $I$ of the $n$ coordinates. The evaluation function of $T$ equals the function that assigns to each input $x\in\{0,1\}^n$ the sum over all paths $P$ of $T$ of $P$'s output multiplied by the indicator that $x$ matches the coordinate values specified by $P$.
hypotheses_covered: real-output decision tree T indexed by I
